% Derived from the documented circular shadow and glow styles in tikzlibraryshadows.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{shadows}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[help lines,gray!35] (0,0) grid (5,3);
  \filldraw[circular drop shadow={opacity=.8},fill=yellow!30,draw=black]
    (1.25,1.25) circle (.55);
  \filldraw[circular glow={fill=purple!70},fill=white,draw=black]
    (3,0.75) rectangle (4.5,2.15);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
